content:
maria: Quick sync — planning to announce next feature pack + perf improvements on Thu 2026-09-02 at 10:00am PT. Need: single changelog permalink, docs anchor, final rollout cadence, and two subject-line variants for A/B.

jules: We can do staged ramp: EU canary 09:30 PT (5%), US canary 09:40 PT (10%), then 50% at 09:50, 100% by 10:00 if metrics stable. Ops threshold: hold if p95 > 2x baseline or error-rate >0.7% for 4m.

ryan: Changelog PR is open: https://github.com/redwood/release-notes/pull/312  has bullets but needs the hero perf sentence. Also added a brief migration note.

sophia: Docs PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/281 — includes examples and a how-to for pinning model variants. Waiting on the concise perf blurb and a rollback paragraph.

maria: Marketing needs a tight headline (one line) + one supporting stat for the post and the changelog. Also we want two subject lines for the email A/B test.

ryan: Draft hero line: "Batch-warming + adaptive batching cut median gen latency 26% and trimmed per-1k token cost by ~22%." Supporting stat: median 118ms -> 87ms.

jules: Ops will validate the numbers in the benchmark harness. If verified, we can drop the exact stat into the PR.

maria: Subject A: "Faster responses, lower cost — our latest runtime update". Subject B: "Cut latency 26% — what this means for your app". Which reads better for partners?

sophia: Subject B seems stronger for devs. Also prepping a short explainer slide and the webinar registration copy.

salesops: CRM tag = "sep_release_2026". SLA: 48h lead follow-up. Please ensure webforms + webinar reg include this tag. Well verify ingestion in staging.

ryan: Example webhook payload to send to sales CRM (staging):

```json
{
  "email": "lead@example.com",
  "name": "Alex Example",
  "tags": ["sep_release_2026","webinar_signup"],
  "utm_source": "release_banner"
}
```

Well add the middleware to inject the tag on form submit.

jules: Also adding a feature-flag gate: release_flag=runtime_v2. Well flip the flag per cohort during rollouts. If an alarm triggers we flip back immediate.

eng-ci-bot: Bench job completed: job/bench-2026-09-01-16 finished. Results: median=87ms, p95=310ms, cost_per_1k=$0.34. Link: https://ci.redwood.ai/bench/job/bench-2026-09-01-16.

ryan: Dropping numbers into docs PR now and adding a short note about the rollback auto-fallback to stable if errors exceed threshold.

maria: Webinar details: Tue 9:00am PT panel with eng + product. Need a 2-min terminal demo clip showing the latency delta and the model pinning flow. Who records?

sophia: I can stitch the clip once someone records. Ryan, can you record the terminal run and a quick feature-flag flip?

ryan: Yep — will upload to https://drive.redwood.ai/releases/media/perf-clip-sep02.mp4 by EOD. Also creating a 1-slide summary for the email.

maria: Marketing will include a 1-question post-release survey in the email asking "Did you notice faster responses?" with CTA leading to the feature page. That helps our quality monitoring.

jules: Ops will run a smoke test suite at canary start and at 50% ramp. If smoke fails, runbook step: flip release_flag->off and page #incidents.

eng-ci-bot: Runbook attached: /runbooks/releases/2026-09-02-runtime-v2. Canary start scheduled: 2026-09-02T16:30:00Z.

maria: Final checklist for marketing to push the post: 1) changelog PR merged with permalink, 2) docs anchor published, 3) webinar registration live + email subject A/B ready, 4) demo clip uploaded, 5) CRM webhook test OK, 6) ops green at 10:00am PT. Who owns the merge?

ryan: I can merge the changelog once docs have the perf line and legal flags are cleared. Ping me when both are done.

salesops: Weve got a staging endpoint to test tag ingestion: https://crm-staging.redwood.ai/webhook/test. Please send a test payload after the form change.

sophia: Docs anchor will be published at https://docs.redwood.ai/release/2026-09-runtime-v2 once I merge. Ill post the link here.

jules: Ops thresholds re-stated: hold if p95 > 2x baseline OR sustained error-rate >0.7% for 4m. Rollback auto-fallback and manual runbook steps exist.

eng-ci-bot: Canary started: EU region. Deploy logs: https://deploys.redwood.ai/logs/175432. Monitor channel: #release-watch.

maria: Holding publish until ops posts green. Email A/B to be split 50/50, well measure open rate + CTA clicks. Also add a UTM param for the subject line variant.

eng-ci-bot: Rollout ramp complete: 100% traffic at 10:02am PT. Post-deploy checks passed.

maria: Copy. Changelog merged: https://github.com/redwood/release-notes/commit/4f2a9c. Docs published and anchor: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/2026-09-runtime-v2. Demo clip uploaded. CRM test payload received and tag shows up in staging.

salesops: Verified tag ingestion and lead queueing. All good.

maria: Publishing post now and queuing social + email (subject B selected for dev list). Thanks team — great coordination :rocket:
